name: Gmail
description: Official on-device Gmail and IMAP/SMTP integration with multilingual AI orchestration, live status Flutter UI cards, inbox reading, and SMTP sending.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 2.3.0: Fixed critical Host API namespace mismatch (routes AI tool calls to 'email' instead of 'gmail'), fixed 'read'->'get' action normalization mismatch, restored camelCase config options and lang=<code> stripping, added live configuration & IMAP verification Flutter UI card on bare /gmail, removed all hardcoded static response text in favor of multilingual ai.complete generation, and added Flutter UI cards across all operations (config, status, inbox, read, send, disconnect).

tools.description: Official Gmail & IMAP/SMTP email manager in ANY language. CRITICAL: Always include "tool":"gmail" and output ONLY ONE valid JSON object with no extra text or markdown. Supported actions: (1) "config" — connect an email account requiring "email" and "password" (IMPORTANT: Google App Passwords are often written as 4 space-separated 4-letter groups like "abcd efgh ijkl mnop"; ALWAYS capture the ENTIRE password including all 4 groups verbatim in "password"; optionally include "imapHost"/"imapPort"/"smtpHost"/"smtpPort" for custom servers). (2) "status" — check whether Gmail is configured and test live IMAP connectivity. (3) "inbox" — fetch and summarize recent inbox messages. (4) "read" — open a full email by "id". (5) "send" — send an email via SMTP requiring "to", "subject", and "body" (if user asks you to draft an email, write a clear "subject" and complete "body" in their language). (6) "disconnect" — remove saved credentials. (7) "help" — explain how to get a Google App Password and use Gmail commands. Never invent credentials or IDs.

intentContract.description: ALWAYS emit "tool":"gmail". Interpret email requests in any language for config (preserving full multi-word 16-char App Passwords), status, inbox, read, send, disconnect, or help.

fields.name: password
fields.description: Full App Password including all 4 space-separated groups if present (required for "config").

fields.name: id
fields.description: Message ID string to open (required for "read").

examples.input: config user@gmail.com abcd efgh ijkl mnop
check if my gmail is configured
send an email to alex@example.com with subject Hello and body How are you?
